[ ABOUT THE INITIATIVE & MISSION ]

ABOUT FOCUSBOT LABS

Pioneering tangible Human-Robot Interaction through conversational multimodal intelligence and edge computer vision.

THE FOCUSBOT PARADIGM

Modern knowledge work and academic study are saturated with disruptive digital noise. Smartphones, browser tabs, and notification alerts continuously fracture human cognitive attention. We believe that desktop companions should not simply be static alarms or passive mobile timers; they should possess situational spatial awareness, physical warmth, and genuine communicative agency.

FocusBot was conceived to transform the desk experience into a sanctuary of sustained focus and calm well-being. Using a wide-angle edge camera, FocusBot gently recognizes when you are immersed in deep study, taking a well-earned break, or falling into a mobile distraction loop.

By unifying Google Gemini's multimodal conversational reasoning with affordable maker hardware, our mission is to make embodied, empathetic desk robotics a ubiquitous reality for students and researchers worldwide.

TENET // 01

Embodied Physical Presence

HRI research consistently shows that physical embodiment (smooth pan-tilt head nods, gaze following) triggers substantially greater user compliance and empathy than flat screen pop-ups or smartphone notifications.

TENET // 02

Privacy-By-Design

Vision classification operates directly at the local edge. No raw camera video feeds are stored, recorded, or broadcast to cloud databases, guaranteeing absolute peace of mind at your personal desk.

TENET // 03

Adaptive AI Empathy

Powered by Google Gemini multimodal synapses, FocusBot does not bark generic commands. It understands study fatigue, encourages restorative breaks, and offers supportive conversational check-ins.
